stories.title: 10-year US Treasury yields surges over 5.05% to 19-year high

en.title: 10-year US Treasury yields surges over 5.05% to 19-year high
en.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield reached 5.058%, its highest level since July 2007, driven by fresh economic data that raised concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate increases. The rising yields put significant downward pressure on equity markets, especially technology and growth-oriented stocks.

en.summary: The Indian rupee weakened to 95.74 against the dollar on September 23 as expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes strengthened the dollar globally. State-run banks attempted to limit the rupee's decline through dollar sales.
